spec.note: Full working design specification (Reception Protocol Spec v1.0). Sections marked SKLENJENO are settled; sections marked OSNUTEK are open drafts under multi-agent review.

notes: AI agents must always communicate with Reception.
Do not call internal business APIs directly.
Entry point and search target are separate concepts.
For a usable Request Envelope example, send GET to the reception endpoint (returns 405 + sample_request). Actual search requires POST.
